description: Held-out intent routing set. Hand-written; none of these appear in the classifier prototypes or in benchmark_questions_multi.json. 'coarse' maps each item onto the 6 labels of the older LogReg classifier for a like-for-like comparison.

items.q: Our lab spends about $130k a year on reagents with one distributor. Do we need to run a formal bid?
What's the cutoff above which UC must solicit competitive bids?
Is a $95,000 furniture order exempt from bidding?
We want to use a disabled veteran business enterprise for a $180K job. Do we skip the bid?
Does a five-year maintenance agreement at $30K per year count as over the bid limit?
Which parts of the source selection form do I fill out if I got three quotes?
Is price reasonableness documentation needed for a $70K sole-source on a DOE contract?
At what amount does a grant-funded purchase need the SSPR?
Do I attach the SSPR to a non-federal $150,000 requisition?
If 20% of the cost is on my NIH award and the rest is gift funds, do federal procurement standards apply?
What extra verifications are required when buying with DOD contract money?
Are the UC terms and conditions flow-downs different for cooperative agreements?
What is the simplified acquisition threshold and does UC use it?
My chair told me to put the laptops on three different POs so nothing hits the bid limit. Is that okay?
Can two departments each order half of a shared instrument to stay below the threshold?
Is staggering monthly orders to one vendor a way around competitive bidding?
The vendor helped us write the specs so only their product fits. Can we sole source it?
Is being the lowest price a valid reason for a single-source award?
We need parts that match our existing equipment from the original manufacturer. What justification do we use?
A staff member resigned last month and now wants to sell us services. Is there a waiting period?
Are retirees barred from being UC suppliers?
Can a former buyer represent a vendor in negotiations with her old department?
Facilities wants a private firm to handle laundry for the residence halls. Is that permitted?
Do we have to pay a contracted parking attendant company the same as UC staff?
How much notice does AFSCME get before we renew a custodial contract?
Can we bring in a temp agency for housekeeping during a staffing shortage?
Our new freezer cost $7,200. Does it get a CAAN?
Are computer accessories bought later added to the equipment record?
Who is responsible for the physical inventory of university equipment?
We are paying a photographer for one event. Employee or contractor?
Can a current UC employee also be paid as an independent contractor by another department?
What factors show someone is really an employee rather than a 1099 worker?
A supplier offered me concert tickets. Can I take them?
My spouse's company is responding to our RFP. Should I recuse myself?
Do I need to disclose owning shares in a lab supply company I buy from?
A SaaS survey tool will store student emails. What data protection terms are required?
Our clinic's billing vendor sees patient records. What agreement do we need?
What does IS-3 require from vendors hosting university systems?
Does a small moving company need auto liability insurance to work on campus?
Can we waive the insurance requirement for a one-day workshop presenter?
What indemnification language protects UC in a services contract?
How do I get reimbursed for a business dinner with a visiting speaker?
Who can sign contracts on behalf of the Regents?
What are the rules for disposing of surplus property?
Can I buy a gift card as an award for an employee?
